question: In a certain code language, ‘DRUM’ is coded as ‘2194’ and ‘CURD’ is coded as ‘4592’. What is the code for ‘C’ in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘DRUM’ is coded as ‘2194’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3904cfc5d3cc1a7cc54daed35444f5aff5a97722b0d4cde2d500a53dfa1f9889.png] 

‘CURD’ is coded as ‘4592’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7d30e93abdd7cc4efd9b2073cd3f82542115ff3b5d5d4b86a379225dd25bc9f.png] 

So, '**5**' is the code for ‘C’ in the given code language.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
